workspaces.label: Reception & Front Desk
workspaces.description: Registration, returning-patient lookup, OPD slips, queue management, refunds/waivers, counter cash.

screens.title: Patient document vault
screens.purpose: Scan and attach referral letters, reports from other facilities, ID copies and the Patient Photo to the patient's record.

tasks.summary: List patient documents
Upload a patient document (PDF/JPEG/PNG)
Download a patient document

rules: Upload PDF, JPEG or PNG (multipart/form-data, at most MAX_UPLOAD_MB): UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE for another type, a PDF as the Photo or a file that is not what it claims; VALIDATION_ERROR for a damaged image, an outside document without its facility or a future date; PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (details.max_bytes) above the limit.

'Reports brought by the patient' (optional, any number): file (PDF, or a JPEG/PNG scan or photo of the paper), type (LabReport, Imaging, DischargeSummary, Prescription, ReferralLetter, Other), title (the test or report, e.g. 'CBC'), issued by (source_facility, required) and the date on it (document_date) → POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents with is_outside=true. List them labelled 'Outside: <facility>, <date>', apart from this hospital's own results: they are never shown or counted as this hospital's lab or imaging results.

Patient Photo is OPTIONAL here and everywhere (never a required field, never a blocker): offer 'Take photo' (camera) or 'Choose file' (JPEG or PNG), preview, retake, and 'Skip' needing no reason. Ask first; respect a refusal (purdah, privacy) and never delay an emergency, an injured face or a patient who cannot cooperate. Upload it after the patient exists: POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents doc_type=Photo, its own Idempotency-Key, so a failed upload never repeats a registration, a payment or an admission. Show photo_document_id (patient, admission) through GET /patient-documents/{document_id}/download.
Every download is logged as a patient-data read: open documents only when the user asks for them.

screens.title: Patient search
screens.purpose: Find returning patients by MRN, mobile, CNIC or name; show outstanding dues banner.

tasks.summary: Update demographics (optimistic locking)
Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN
Patient profile (+ outstanding banner, merged profiles)
Dues, receivables and invoices across the merge chain
Panels (Sehat Sahulat, Zakat, corporate ...)

rules: Search as the user types (debounce 250 ms); a USB scanner types an MRN barcode + Enter.
If outstanding.has_outstanding_ar: show outstanding.banner_text in a red banner above the patient card.
Merged records resolve to the master record automatically; never show merged duplicates as separate patients.

matched_merged_profile set: the search found the patient by a profile merged into this record (the MRN on an old slip, a trauma label): show the master record and say 'Found by <its mrn>, merged into this record', so a scanned slip whose MRN differs is not taken for a wrong match.
mlc_numbers not empty: a red MEDICO-LEGAL banner with the numbers (MSDS 154). is_deceased: a DECEASED banner (death_at); never start a new visit for a deceased patient.

screens.title: New registration + OPD slip
screens.purpose: One atomic call: patient → OPD ticket → invoice → payment → queue token → print payload.

tasks.summary: Upload a patient document (PDF/JPEG/PNG)
List patient documents
Download a patient document
Register a patient (full intake form)
Collect payment for an unpaid ticket (then queues it)
Register + OPD slip + payment + queue token (atomic)
Hospital service prices (lab prices live in the lab catalogue)
OPD slip print payload (text + barcode + QR)
All queues, deferred tickets, pending approvals, cash-back prompts
Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)
The doctors who see an OPD queue (the re-route and slip picker)
Panels (Sehat Sahulat, Zakat, corporate ...)
Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN

rules: Always send an Idempotency-Key header: one UUID per registration the user starts, the same one on every retry of it (a second click after a lost answer is a retry), so a retry never double-charges.
Only name, gender, age/DOB and mobile are required for Regular patients; CNIC optional.

Patient Photo is OPTIONAL here and everywhere (never a required field, never a blocker): offer 'Take photo' (camera) or 'Choose file' (JPEG or PNG), preview, retake, and 'Skip' needing no reason. Ask first; respect a refusal (purdah, privacy) and never delay an emergency, an injured face or a patient who cannot cooperate. Upload it after the patient exists: POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents doc_type=Photo, its own Idempotency-Key, so a failed upload never repeats a registration, a payment or an admission. Show photo_document_id (patient, admission) through GET /patient-documents/{document_id}/download.

'Reports brought by the patient' (optional, any number): file (PDF, or a JPEG/PNG scan or photo of the paper), type (LabReport, Imaging, DischargeSummary, Prescription, ReferralLetter, Other), title (the test or report, e.g. 'CBC'), issued by (source_facility, required) and the date on it (document_date) → POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents with is_outside=true. List them labelled 'Outside: <facility>, <date>', apart from this hospital's own results: they are never shown or counted as this hospital's lab or imaging results.

Discount above the user's ceiling → DISCOUNT_CEILING_EXCEEDED (details.max_pct): issue the ticket within the ceiling, then offer 'Request VIP waiver' with waiver_pct for the rest (Billing Admin / Owner approve).
AR_OUTSTANDING_BLOCK: show the dues banner; Emergency source bypasses the block.
Print print_payload.text on the 80 mm thermal printer mapped to this terminal (GET /terminals/whoami).

The doctor: from GET /opd-queues/doctors (by department, with how many wait), or the department alone; a colleague who sees no OPD queue answers VALIDATION_ERROR (details.field doctor_id). A patient sent to the wrong doctor is re-routed by that doctor: the dashboard moves the patient by itself (opd.queue.updated).

POST /reception/registrations starts new emergency_department work for an emergency patient (source Emergency) without an open emergency visit: offer that choice only while emergency_department is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

screens.title: Lab-only walk-in
screens.purpose: Name + mobile only; creates a lab requisition and lab bill; never touches doctor queues.

tasks.summary: Lab-only walk-in (name + mobile only)
Active lab test catalogue (for the ordering picker)
Collect a payment (lab / pharmacy / final IPD bill ...)
Requisitions of one patient (newest first)
Printable lab report with who performed and who verified each test
The lab report as a PDF

rules: Only full_name and mobile are required.
Collect the lab bill at reception/cashier; lab staff never take cash.

Report collection: find the patient's requisitions (GET /lab/requisitions?patient_id=…) and print the signed report (A4); LAB_REPORT_NOT_READY = nothing verified yet, complete false = some tests are still running.

lab.result.published reaches the walk-in desk (users holding patient.create and lab.requisition.create) for lab-only walk-ins only: when its patient_id or requisition_id is the one on screen, read GET /lab/requisitions?patient_id=… again and offer the report. It is a hint, never the result: the report is ready only when its print-payload read answers. Show no value from the event.

Exists for the service laboratory or outsourced_diagnostics (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id lab_only_walkin (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.

POST /patients/lab-only-walk-in starts new outsourced_diagnostics work for a send-out test (availability SendOut): offer that choice only while outsourced_diagnostics is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

POST /patients/lab-only-walk-in starts new laboratory work for an in-house test (availability InHouse): offer that choice only while laboratory is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

screens.title: Diagnostic services list
screens.purpose: Print the list of tests and examinations done here and those sent to partners, to display for patients.

tasks.summary: The list of diagnostic services to display (PDF)

rules: Print again whenever the lab catalogue or the partners change; tell a patient when a test is sent out (GET /lab/tests: send_out_partner_name).

screens.title: Queue management
screens.purpose: Live queues per doctor; defer / reactivate tickets; cancel unpaid slips.

tasks.summary: Every status/payment/lock change of a ticket
All queues, deferred tickets, pending approvals, cash-back prompts
A doctor's live queue
Defer (patient must leave; keeps the ticket, no refund)
Reactivate a deferred ticket (no new payment)
Cancel an UNPAID ticket
Scan an OPD slip barcode

rules: Reactivation keeps the original token number and needs no new payment while the ticket is valid.
Tickets past valid_until show 'Expired — new visit needs a new slip'.

screens.title: Refund / VIP waiver / credit requests
screens.purpose: Front-line request → locked ticket → approver decides → cash-back prompt.

tasks.summary: Void an unpaid ticket (risk-monitored)
Initiate Refund (needs approval)
Request VIP / 100% waiver BEFORE consultation (needs approval)
Request Credit / Partial Payment
Ticket with invoice, queue entry, pending approval and cash-back prompts
Approval queue visible to me (or my own requests with mine=true)

rules: While approval_lock != None show a visible 'Awaiting approval' state; the patient is off the doctor's screen.
Refunds after clinical activity need the elevated approver and are risk-flagged — suggest the post-consult VIP waiver.
Post-consult waivers end as Waivered (not Refunded) so they never trip fraud sweeps.
The post-consult VIP waiver is the doctor's ('Convert to VIP waiver' on the consultation, opd.waiver.request_post_consult): suggest it to the doctor; the desk never sends it.

screens.title: Mandatory cash-back prompts
screens.purpose: Approved refunds/waivers the counter must hand over now.

tasks.summary: Ticket with invoice, queue entry, pending approval and cash-back prompts
Hand the approved refund back (cash-out)
Confirm Dispensation of waiver cash-back

rules: Show ticket.cash_back_prompts as a blocking modal with the exact amount until confirmed.
Cash leaves YOUR open shift drawer (open one first: SHIFT_NOT_OPEN).

screens.title: Trauma profile merge
screens.purpose: Link a temporary 'Unknown Male 1' (or lab-only) profile into the identified patient's permanent record; merge a duplicate permanent record with a second person.

tasks.summary: Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN
Merge this temporary/duplicate profile into a master profile

rules: The trauma record is kept for audit; clinical data displays under the master profile.
A merge is for good: show both profiles side by side (name, father/husband, sex, date of birth or age, CNIC, mobile, MRN) and ask the user to confirm before sending.
A permanent (Regular) profile merges only with a second person who holds patient.merge.approve: collect cosigner_username/cosigner_password on the same screen (MERGE_COSIGNER_REQUIRED without them).

MERGE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT (details.conflicts: cnic, upmrn, gender, dob, seen_after_death) means two different people: say so, never offer an override; correct the wrong profile first (PATCH /patients/{patient_id}).

screens.title: My cash shift
screens.purpose: Open/close the drawer; see collections by type; hand over the cash drop.

tasks.summary: Open my cash shift at a counter
My open shift (if any)
Drawer ledger of a shift
Close shift → PendingCollection

rules: Every cash action needs an open shift at this counter (node from GET /terminals/whoami cash_node).
Closing asks for the counted cash; the Accountant verifies it later.

The drawer is counted whole: expected_cash includes the opening float (1500 for a float of 1500 and no movement). Ask the cashier to count everything in the drawer, the float included, and show declared_variance after the close; never subtract the float or compute a balance yourself.

In the Pharmacy workspace the drawer must be the Pharmacy Counter's (node PharmacyCounter): the pharmacy's cash goes into no other. On a PC whose GET /terminals/whoami cash_node is not PharmacyCounter, say that this PC is not set up for pharmacy cash and IT must map it to the Pharmacy Counter; never let the user pick the counter.

tasks.summary: Record a complaint
The complaints register
One complaint
Record an appeal
The notice of the right to complain (English and Urdu)
A letter to the complainant (print payload)
Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN
Departments
Live bed matrix (counts per ward + optional bed list)

Send an Idempotency-Key.

tasks.summary: The tariff: every price, by category
The tariff to print and display (PDF)

screens.title: Record patient feedback
screens.purpose: The client satisfaction form: an exit interview at the end of the visit, or a paper form from the suggestion box typed in as it was filled.
screens.workflow: The clinic manual, indicator 45 and Annex A (decisions 25)

tasks.summary: Record a patient's feedback (Annex A)
The blank client satisfaction form (PDF)
Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN
All queues, deferred tickets, pending approvals, cash-back prompts

rules: Question 1: satisfied Yes / No. Yes shows the ten 'how' reasons, No the thirteen 'why not' reasons (the form's wording: frontend-docs/workflows/clinic-quality-and-education.md); several may be ticked; Other needs its text.
Anonymous by default; name the visit (ticket_id) only when the respondent agrees.
Print blank forms for the suggestion box with GET /patient-feedback/form/pdf.

shared_screens.title: Report an incident
shared_screens.purpose: Anyone reports an incident, an adverse event or a near miss, the same day, without blame.

tasks.summary: What to report: the incident types
Report an incident, an adverse event or a near miss
The incident register
One incident
The list of sentinel events and how to report (PDF)
Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)
Departments
Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN
Live bed matrix (counts per ward + optional bed list)

rules: A button on every workspace's toolbar. Form: the type (GET /incident-types, grouped by area, sentinel types marked), incident or near miss, harm, when (now by default) and where (department, ward, place), who was affected (a patient: search by MRN; staff: GET /staff/lookup, any reporter may use it), what happened (facts, not blame) and what was done at once; 'Keep my name confidential' (reporter_confidential).
Medication errors: the stage and the medicine; theatre events: the operation and the phase (INCIDENT_DETAILS_REQUIRED). Send an Idempotency-Key: a double click must not report twice.
After sending: show the incident number and 'The Quality Officer will review it'. 'My reports' = GET /incidents?mine=true.
Link 'What to report' to GET /incidents/sentinel-list/pdf.

Patient fields by permission: offer the patient search (GET /patients/search), the admissions (GET /admissions), the operations (GET /ot/bookings), the death records (GET /deaths), the formulary (GET /drugs/search) and the wards (GET /beds/matrix?include_beds=false) only to a user holding a permission the call accepts (its x-permissions against GET /auth/me); anyone else describes the patient in the text.

shared_screens.title: Incidents I investigate
shared_screens.purpose: The analysis of an incident the Quality Officer asked you to investigate, and its actions.

tasks.summary: The incident register
One incident
Save the analysis (a draft until signed)
Sign the analysis (final)
Record a corrective or preventive action
The incident report with its analysis and actions (PDF)
Departments
Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)

rules: List: GET /incidents?mine=true&status=UnderReview (analysis_overdue in red). Show it only to users who have one (notification category incident when named).

Analysis form (save as you go with PUT): method (RootCauseAnalysis for a sentinel event), what happened in order, root causes, contributing factors (checkboxes of the fixed list), lessons, whether the patient or the family was told and how, any report made outside (DRAP, PHC).
Sign: INCIDENT_ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE lists details.missing. A sentinel event needs at least one factor of the system, not only 'Individual' or 'Patient' (MSDS CQI 107: blame alone is not an analysis).
Add the corrective and preventive actions with an owner and a due date.

shared_screens.title: Connect to server (first run / server unreachable)
shared_screens.purpose: Find the hospital server, trust its certificate once, remember its addresses. Full contract and Electron code: the 'Connecting terminals' guide.

tasks.summary: How terminals reach and trust this server — works before login
Identify this terminal (location + mapped printers) — works before login

rules: Order: policy registry HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Haspataal\Terminal > %ProgramData%\Haspataal Terminal\terminal.json > the saved choice > this screen.
This screen: broadcast a LAN discovery request (UDP 47632) and list the servers found; also allow typing an address (https://SERVER-NAME).
Before trusting a server the first time, show its CA fingerprint and require IT to confirm it matches the Control Center (skip the question only when a provisioned fingerprint matches).
Pin the hospital CA; never accept a server whose CA fingerprint differs from the trusted one (show 'This is not your hospital server').
After connecting, call GET /meta/server-info and store ALL urls as alternates; if the one in use fails during a shift, try the others before showing 'Server unreachable'.
While unreachable: keep the current screen and unsaved input, show a banner, retry with back-off (1, 2, 5, 10, 30 s), resume the WebSocket with resume_from when back.

shared_screens.title: Login
shared_screens.purpose: First screen on every terminal: username/password, LAN diagnostics, terminal identity overlay.

tasks.summary: Log in (returns tokens, profile, roles, workspaces)
Identify this terminal (location + mapped printers) — works before login
Change own password
The server's license state: show a banner when it needs attention — works before login
Is the server there? (unauthenticated, no database)
Server health (unauthenticated; used by the login screen)

rules: Before showing the form, ping GET /health/live every 5 s; if it fails show 'LAN / server unreachable' (cable, Wi-Fi, server) instead of hanging. When it answers, GET /health says whether the server is degraded (HTTP 503, its database down: 'The server is starting or has a problem: ask IT'), in maintenance, or licensed (license.state).

In maintenance (GET /health maintenance_mode) show maintenance_message word for word: it is the text IT wrote in the Control Center (e.g. 'Back at 02:30'), never replace it with one of your own; keep polling until maintenance_mode is false.

License banner: GET /meta/license on this screen (and data.license after login, the system.license event, every 10 min). state grace = persistent banner with message, days_left and the vendor contact on EVERY screen, work continues; state locked = only the Super Admin can log in, others get LICENSE_INVALID at login and token refresh (show message + details.vendor).
Show the terminal MAC/IP overlay (Ctrl+Shift+I or an info icon) from GET /terminals/whoami for IT support.

A Settings button (and Ctrl+,) opens the Settings window before login: GET /settings/sections without a token answers signed_in false and the This terminal tier only (connection and LAN diagnostics, this terminal's location and printers, the login screen's language and zoom). It writes nothing on the server.
If user.must_change_password is true, force the change-password form before anything else (other endpoints answer PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED).
ACCOUNT_LOCKED / RATE_LIMITED: show error.message and error.retry_after_seconds; never retry automatically.
Store the refresh token with Electron safeStorage; keep the access token in memory only.

shared_screens.title: Workspace launcher
shared_screens.purpose: Multi-role users pick a workspace; single-workspace users skip this screen.

tasks.summary: Workspaces the user may open (multi-role launch screen)
Current user, roles, permissions, workspaces, preferences
The establishment's profile and services, with the configuration revision

rules: If exactly one workspace: open it directly.

My Workspace (self_service; every_employee true in GET /auth/workspaces, roles usually []) is every employee's, listed after the role workspaces. Open it like any workspace (its window sends X-Active-Workspace: self_service), but do not count it for the launcher: a user with one role workspace opens that one directly and reaches My Workspace from the user's menu, a multi-role user also from the launcher. A guest login (the PHC inspector) has no My Workspace.
Allow opening several workspaces in separate windows at once.

Every request of a workspace window sends X-Active-Workspace: <its code> (one of GET /auth/workspaces; another answers WORKSPACE_NOT_ALLOWED): the audit trail records the window, and F1 help defaults to it. The launcher sends none. It never changes what the user may do.
Hide menu items whose x-permissions the user lacks (permissions are in /auth/me).

One build of the frontend serves every profile (Clinic, II C, II B, II A, I) and every change of it: nothing is downloaded or switched by a flag. Read GET /establishment after login and again on establishment.changed, then list each workspace as views.workspaces says (hidden: not listed; records: marked Records; open_work: with the banner) and each screen as views.screens says; a workspace or screen it does not list is core and always shown (to the users with its permissions). Inside a screen hide an operation of x-capability-gates (or only the choice its `when` names) while its service is not in `active` (the server refuses it anyway: CAPABILITY_INACTIVE). What is shown follows the services, never the profile's category: the category picks the inspection framework, the letterhead and the few rules a screen names (the clinic's complete consultation).

shared_screens.title: Settings (avatar or Ctrl+,)
shared_screens.purpose: One Settings window in every workspace: my preferences and password; the facility's profile, services and policy settings; IT's users, hardware and emergency actions: each tier only for the users it belongs to.

tasks.summary: The Settings window: the tiers and sections this caller may open (also before login)
My preferences (theme, language, UI scale, PDF download)
Update my preferences (only the fields you send)
Change my password (same as /auth/change-password)
Request a control-setting or privileged-access change (applied at once for an Owner)

rules: Theme: Light / DarkHighContrast.
Language en/ur is per USER (loaded at login), not per machine; bundle Noto Nastaliq Urdu; no bilingual labels in grids.
UI scale slider (100–250 %) and Ctrl +/- drive the SAME Electron zoom factor; persist via PUT /settings/me.
'Documents' section: 'Download a set of documents (the PHC inspection pack) as: separate PDFs, one per click (default) / one combined PDF' → pdf_download Separate | Combined. Never offer a ZIP.

Open it from the avatar menu or Ctrl+, (Cmd+, on macOS) in every workspace; build its navigation from GET /settings/sections, never from role names: the facility tier opens facility_profile and the policy settings, the system tier opens the IT console's parts.
Policy settings marked is_control show 'Owner approval': for anyone but an Owner, Save sends POST /admin/change-requests and the row shows 'Waiting for an Owner' until approval.resolved.

Before login the same window opens from the login screen with the This terminal tier only (signed_in false): Server connection and LAN diagnostics (GET /health, GET /meta/server-info: the addresses and the CA fingerprint, GET /meta/license), This terminal (GET /terminals/whoami: location, printers, cash node, the MAC sent as X-Terminal-Mac), and the login screen's language and zoom, kept on this terminal until a user logs in (then GET /settings/me decides). After login the tier stays, last.

shared_screens.title: Help: the end-user handbook
shared_screens.purpose: The searchable, role-filtered handbook of the software for the hospital's staff, shipped inside the app: how to use each screen they may use, step by step, in English and Urdu, so the hospital needs no software training.

tasks.summary: The end-user handbook's outline for the logged-in employee (only what they may use)
My preferences (theme, language, UI scale, PDF download)

rules: Build the handbook as the developer guide 'The end-user handbook' (get_guide('end-user-handbook')) says: one page per screen (screens/<screen id>) and one per workspace (workspaces/<code>), written for the hospital's staff (where to click, what happens, what the system refuses and why, what to do on each error message), in English and Urdu (the user's language preference, GET /settings/me), with screenshots of YOUR UI.

RBAC is the server's: GET /meta/handbook after login (and after a role change) returns the pages this user may read; show only those pages in the help window and in its search index; a page whose screen is not in the answer is never shown, linked or searchable for this user.

Localhost-only searchable site: the pages are a static site generated at the app's build (MkDocs-style with a client-side search index), bundled in the app and served to the help window from an HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port (or a custom app:// protocol); never on the LAN, never on the hospital server. Works offline. Print-friendly for the training room.

Entry points: 'Help' in the avatar menu (opens the user's handbook home: their workspaces and a search box) and a '?' button on every screen (opens screens/<id>). The home lists the user's own workspaces first (yours true).
Keep it current: the page ids are the screen ids of the catalogue; what_changed in the MCP server lists screens added or changed since the last build, so the pages are revised with the UI.
In a workspace window, call GET /meta/handbook?workspace=<that workspace>; never show another workspace's pages in that window.

ICD picker: browse chapters, blocks, categories

The ICD code lists loaded

rules: Search as the doctor types (from 2 characters, debounced): a code prefix (CA40) or words in any order ("pneumonia bacterial"); show code in bold, title, and parent_title in grey to tell similar titles apart.

Residual codes (is_residual: "other specified", "unspecified") after the specific ones: nudge toward the most specific code. 'Browse' walks chapters → blocks → codes (GET /icd/browse?parent=…); a code's place in the tree: GET /icd/codes/{code}.
The classification is GET /icd/releases → coding_system (ICD-11 unless the hospital switched to its licensed ICD-10); ICD_SYSTEM_NOT_LOADED: no list of that classification yet.
Show `icd11_citation` in small print at the picker's foot (the ICD-11 licence requires the attribution).
Store only the code; everywhere codes come back they come with `icd_terms` (code, title, WHO URI): show code + title, never a bare code.

rules: Requesters see their own pending items with GET /approvals?mine=true and a visible 'Awaiting approval' state.

Show Approve and Reject only when the request's can_decide is true; decide_blocked says why not (own_request, missing_permission, decided). You never approve your own request (SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN): self_decision forbidden shows 'Awaiting another approver'; allowed_with_note (the Owner of a solo practice, solo_practice_mode in GET /meta/settings) asks for the note, and the answer comes back solo_self_approved.
Reject requires a note. No co-signer is typed in this queue: a large cash drop is simply never approved by the cashier of its shift (DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON).
PolicyChange and PrivilegedAccess requests carry payload.current_value and payload.requested_value: show both and the reason before Approve.

shared_screens.title: PHC inspection interview practice
shared_screens.purpose: Every member of staff rehearses the questions the PHC's surveyors may ask them, with answers that quote the hospital's own settings and records, a few minutes a day.
shared_screens.workflow: PHC inspection interviews (the vendor's request of 2026-10-08)

tasks.summary: My practice deck: the question of the day and what to rehearse now
One question: other ways of asking, the model answer with the hospital's facts, key points, follow-ups, pitfalls, what to show
Record how well I knew a question (Knew, Partly, DidNotKnow)
My readiness: questions known, chapter by chapter, my streak and my last mock interview
The PHC inspection interview questions (filter by role, chapter, indicator, type, words)
The roles and how many inspection interview questions each rehearses
A role's pocket guide: questions, key points and model answers (PDF)
A role's pocket guide as a print payload, in English or Urdu
Mock interviews, newest first (staff who do not conduct them see their own)
One mock interview: each answer and the actions it raised

rules: Login card (every workspace, msds.interview.practice): `question_of_the_day` from GET .../my-deck with a 'Practise' button; hide it when null.

Flashcard: show the question (and, on 'Ask it differently', one of `variants`); the user answers aloud or in their head; 'Show the answer' reveals `model_answer`, then the `key_points` as a checklist; three buttons Knew / Partly / Didn't know → POST .../rehearsals; then the next card of `due`. Show `follow_ups` as 'The surveyor may ask next', `pitfalls` as 'Avoid', `show_me` as 'Be ready to show'.

The aim is that staff can explain what they actually do, as the hospital's SOPs say: never present the model answer as a script to memorise. Show under every answer: 'If a key point is not true on your ward, tell your in-charge: it is a gap to fix, not a line to learn.' (the answer's `notice`, in its language)
Facts: values from the hospital's settings are already filled in `model_answer`; a fact with `set` false shows as a bracketed prompt: never invent a value.
Badges: the PHC type (Mandatory red, Operational yellow, always with its word), the indicator number in the hospital's category (`indicators_in_category`), 'Adapted to our SOP' when `adapted`.
Progress (GET .../my-progress): ready %, the streak, per chapter knew / partly / not known / not rehearsed; the last mock interview with its score (open it: GET .../mock-interviews/{id}).

Browse all (GET .../questions?mine=true, then any role) and 'Print my pocket guide': in English GET .../pocket-guide/pdf (a PDF: one click, one file); in Urdu GET .../pocket-guide?lang=ur, laid out by the app right to left and printed from the terminal (the server's PDFs are Latin script only).
INTERVIEW_QUESTION_NOT_APPLICABLE: the hospital took the question out; drop the card and refresh the deck.

Language (the vendor's request of 2026-10-09): send `lang` (en or ur) or rely on the user's preference (PUT /settings/me language); every answer says its `lang`, so offer an English / اردو switch on every card. Urdu (`direction` rtl): lay the texts out right to left in Noto Nastaliq Urdu (bundled in the app); medicine names, test names and the hospital's own records inside stay in English as typed. `text_status` Draft: show 'Draft translation' beside the answer until the vendor's native-speaker review; `question_en` gives the English wording a surveyor may use.

shared_screens.title: Mock PHC interviews
shared_screens.purpose: A supervisor questions a member of staff as the PHC's surveyor would, records each answer and turns the gaps in practice into corrective actions.
shared_screens.workflow: PHC inspection interviews (the vendor's request of 2026-10-08)

tasks.summary: Mock interviews, newest first (staff who do not conduct them see their own)
One mock interview: each answer and the actions it raised
The roles and how many inspection interview questions each rehearses
One question: other ways of asking, the model answer with the hospital's facts, key points, follow-ups, pitfalls, what to show
The action register (mine: the actions I own)
Departments

rules: Only for msds.interview.conduct. Pick the member of staff (GET .../staff; staff without a login are listed too, `is_me` greyed) and the role, then 'Plan' → GET .../mock-interviews/plan (count 6): the questions with their `reason`; the examiner may swap any for another of the role (GET .../questions?role=).

During the interview show the examiner one question at a time with its `key_points` (GET .../questions/{key}) and, hidden behind a toggle, the model answer; never show the answer to the person questioned.

Each answer: Met / PartlyMet / NotMet; a note is required unless Met (VALIDATION_ERROR). When the answer shows a gap in PRACTICE (the SOP is not followed, equipment is missing) offer 'Raise an action': type, description, owner (a user_id from GET .../staff), due date.

Save once at the end → POST .../mock-interviews with an Idempotency-Key; show the score and the actions (they appear in the action register, GET /quality/actions?source=MockInterview). MOCK_INTERVIEW_SELF: nobody examines themselves.
History: GET .../mock-interviews (filters: employee, role). Staff without conduct see only their own.
Language: the plan, the questions and the reasons come in the examiner's language (`lang`); ask in the language the member of staff works in, as the surveyors do.

faq_seed.question: The Patient search screen says "A patient with this CNIC already exists." (PATIENT_CNIC_EXISTS). Why, and what do I do?

The Patient search screen says "Registration type change not allowed." (PATIENT_TYPE_TRANSITION_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "Open a cash shift before handling cash." (SHIFT_NOT_OPEN). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "This ticket is no longer active; a new visit needs a new ticket." (TICKET_NOT_ACTIVE). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "The payment exceeds the balance due." (OVERPAYMENT). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "The invoice is locked pending approval." (INVOICE_LOCKED). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "This invoice cannot take payments." (INVOICE_NOT_PAYABLE). Why, and what do I do?
What do the states of a ticket mean (Issued, Waiting, InConsultation, Examined, Completed, Deferred, Expired, Forfeited, Refunded, Void, Cancelled), and what moves it from one to the next?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "The patient has outstanding dues; settle or override before issuing a new slip." (AR_OUTSTANDING_BLOCK). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "The discount exceeds your ceiling: issue the ticket within it and request a VIP waiver for the rest." (DISCOUNT_CEILING_EXCEEDED). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "This patient record was merged; use the master record." (PATIENT_MERGED_CANNOT_TRANSACT). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "Lab-only walk-in patients cannot enter doctor queues." (LAB_ONLY_QUEUE_FORBIDDEN). Why, and what do I do?
The New registration + OPD slip screen says "This service is not active here, so no new work of it can start (Settings, facility; GET /establishment)." (CAPABILITY_INACTIVE). Why, and what do I do?
The Lab-only walk-in screen says "No verified result of this requisition to report yet." (LAB_REPORT_NOT_READY). Why, and what do I do?
The Queue management screen says "This ticket cannot move to the requested state." (TICKET_TRANSITION_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?
The Queue management screen says "This record is frozen while an approval is pending." (APPROVAL_PENDING). Why, and what do I do?
The Queue management screen says "This ticket has expired." (TICKET_EXPIRED). Why, and what do I do?
The Queue management screen says "An invoice with payments cannot be cancelled; refund it instead." (INVOICE_HAS_PAYMENTS). Why, and what do I do?
The Refund / VIP waiver / credit requests screen says "The refund exceeds the amount actually paid." (REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAID). Why, and what do I do?
The Refund / VIP waiver / credit requests screen says "A waiver is not possible in the ticket's current state." (WAIVER_NOT_ALLOWED). Why, and what do I do?
The Refund / VIP waiver / credit requests screen says "Credit is not possible for this invoice." (CREDIT_NOT_ALLOWED). Why, and what do I do?
The Mandatory cash-back prompts screen says "This waiver cash-back was already handed over." (WAIVER_REFUND_ALREADY_DISPENSED). Why, and what do I do?

The Trauma profile merge screen says "Two permanent records are merged by two people: a second person who holds patient.merge.approve co-signs (cosigner_username, cosigner_password)." (MERGE_COSIGNER_REQUIRED). Why, and what do I do?
The Trauma profile merge screen says "A second authorised person must co-sign this action." (STEP_UP_REQUIRED). Why, and what do I do?
The Trauma profile merge screen says "Too many failed attempts; the account is temporarily locked." (ACCOUNT_LOCKED). Why, and what do I do?
The Trauma profile merge screen says "The second approver must be a different person." (DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON). Why, and what do I do?

The Trauma profile merge screen says "These profiles are two different people (details.conflicts: cnic, upmrn, gender, dob, seen_after_death); correct the wrong profile first, a merge is for good." (MERGE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT). Why, and what do I do?
The Trauma profile merge screen says "These records cannot be merged." (MERGE_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?
The My cash shift screen says "You already have an open shift at this counter." (SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN). Why, and what do I do?
The My cash shift screen says "Cash must go through your own open shift." (SHIFT_NOT_OWNED). Why, and what do I do?
What do the states of a complaint mean (Received, Acknowledged, Resolved, Appealed, Closed, Withdrawn, NotMaintainable), and what moves it from one to the next?
The Record a complaint screen says "The appeal window of this complaint has ended." (COMPLAINT_APPEAL_LATE). Why, and what do I do?

The Record a complaint screen says "The complaint cannot change that way: what was complained of, the acknowledgement, the outcome and the appeal are recorded once." (COMPLAINT_STATE_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?
The Record a complaint screen says "Bed was reserved by another terminal." (BED_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE). Why, and what do I do?

The Report an incident screen says "The incident type needs more detail: a theatre adverse event its operation and phase, a medication error its stage." (INCIDENT_DETAILS_REQUIRED). Why, and what do I do?

The Report an incident screen says "This screening item is not on the list: it was reported or dismissed already, or is outside the screening window." (INCIDENT_SCREENING_DECIDED). Why, and what do I do?
The Report an incident screen says "This incident type is no longer on the hospital's list." (INCIDENT_TYPE_INACTIVE). Why, and what do I do?
What do the states of a incident mean (Reported, UnderReview, Analysed, Closed, Withdrawn), and what moves it from one to the next?
The Report an incident screen says "Bed was reserved by another terminal." (BED_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE). Why, and what do I do?

The Incidents I investigate screen says "The incident cannot change that way: the report is written once, the class decided at the review, the analysis final once signed." (INCIDENT_STATE_INVALID). Why, and what do I do?

The Incidents I investigate screen says "The analysis is not complete: a sentinel event needs a root cause analysis that finds causes in the system, not only in a person." (INCIDENT_ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE). Why, and what do I do?
What do the states of a complaint mean (Received, Acknowledged, Resolved, Appealed, Closed, Withdrawn, NotMaintainable), and what moves it from one to the next?

The Settings (avatar or Ctrl+,) screen says "The session has expired; refresh or log in again." (TOKEN_EXPIRED). Why, and what do I do?
The Settings (avatar or Ctrl+,) screen says "The session was revoked; log in again." (TOKEN_REVOKED). Why, and what do I do?

The Approval queue screen says "You cannot approve your own request." (SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN). Why, and what do I do?
The Approval queue screen says "This approval request was already decided." (APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED). Why, and what do I do?
The Approval queue screen says "The second approver must be a different person." (DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON). Why, and what do I do?
The App shell (every workspace) screen says "Refresh token reuse detected; all sessions of this login were revoked." (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED). Why, and what do I do?
The My committees screen says "Write who attended, the issues, the activities and the outcomes before approving the minutes." (MEETING_MINUTES_INCOMPLETE). Why, and what do I do?
The My committees screen says "The minutes of this meeting are final." (MEETING_FINAL). Why, and what do I do?
The PHC inspection interview practice screen says "No PHC interview question has this key; GET /msds/interview-prep/questions lists them." (INTERVIEW_QUESTION_UNKNOWN). Why, and what do I do?
